decisions.condition: A bearish candle is the final opposite candle before an approved bullish departure.
decisions.outcome: Start or replace the demand candidate at that candle.

decisions.condition: A bullish candle is the final opposite candle before an approved bearish departure.
decisions.outcome: Start or replace the supply candidate at that candle.

decisions.condition: The same-direction departure closes beyond the origin extreme.
decisions.outcome: Confirm a fresh zone on the closed five-minute bar.
Use the origin range plus any permitted formation-envelope distal extension.

decisions.condition: The bearish demand origin high is above the first bullish departure high.
decisions.outcome: Use the full origin body before applying the permitted distal extension.

decisions.condition: The bullish supply origin low is below the first bearish departure low.
decisions.outcome: Use the full origin body before applying the permitted distal extension.

decisions.condition: Consecutive bullish formation candles print lower lows before demand confirmation.
decisions.outcome: Extend only the demand distal boundary downward.

decisions.condition: Consecutive bearish formation candles print higher highs before supply confirmation.
decisions.outcome: Extend only the supply distal boundary upward.

decisions.condition: The pre-origin approach candle has a known direction.
decisions.outcome: Classify continuation when approach matches departure direction; otherwise reversal.

decisions.condition: The origin has no prior bar or its approach candle is a doji.
decisions.outcome: Reject the candidate without guessing a formation class.

decisions.condition: An opposite-color candle appears after formation starts and before confirmation.

decisions.outcome: Freeze top and bottom for the full lifecycle.

decisions.condition: A later bar overlaps the frozen zone and does not close beyond the distal boundary.
decisions.outcome: Change the lifecycle state from fresh to tapped.

decisions.condition: A later overlapping bar closes beyond the frozen distal boundary.
decisions.outcome: Change the lifecycle state from fresh to invalidated.

eligibility_decisions.condition: After raw zone confirmation and before its first tap, fewer than two consecutive opposite-direction liquidity candles have closed in front of it.
eligibility_decisions.outcome: Keep the raw zone visible but do not mark it strategy-eligible.

eligibility_decisions.condition: Only one opposite-direction liquidity candle exists and the discretionary exception cannot be evaluated objectively.
eligibility_decisions.outcome: Keep the raw zone visible and fail closed for strategy eligibility.

eligibility_decisions.condition: At least two opposite-direction liquidity candles have formed, using the wick extreme at the run's starting swing as the anchor, but price has not traded beyond that anchor.
eligibility_decisions.outcome: Keep the raw zone visible and continue waiting without emitting an eligible setup.

eligibility_decisions.condition: More than one completed normal-liquidity swing exists in front of the still-fresh raw zone.
eligibility_decisions.outcome: Use the spatially closest swing as primary; if it has not taken its own extreme, return strategy eligibility to waiting even when an older farther swing was valid.

eligibility_decisions.condition: The raw zone is tapped or invalidated before qualifying liquidity takes its own extreme.
eligibility_decisions.outcome: Keep the raw zone and its lifecycle visible but expire strategy eligibility for that setup.

eligibility_decisions.condition: At least two opposite-direction liquidity candles formed after zone confirmation and price subsequently traded beyond the starting swing's wick high for demand or wick low for supply.
eligibility_decisions.outcome: Mark the still-fresh raw zone as strategy-eligible on the closed five-minute bar.

entry_route_decisions.condition: After a target becomes liquidity-eligible and while it remains fresh, a later closed bar taps a confirmed opposite-direction raw zone located fully in front of the target.
entry_route_decisions.outcome: Expire strategy eligibility for the target while leaving both raw zones and their lifecycle states visible.

setup_decisions.condition: The raw target remains fresh when its primary liquidity candidate takes its own extreme on a closed five-minute bar.
setup_decisions.outcome: Arm a non-executable setup handoff while continuing to wait for the target's first return.

setup_decisions.condition: A closer completed primary liquidity candidate appears after a setup was armed but has not yet taken its own extreme.
setup_decisions.outcome: Return the setup handoff to waiting; do not reject it unless another terminal rule applies.

setup_decisions.condition: A later closed five-minute bar first overlaps an armed target and does not close beyond its distal boundary.
setup_decisions.outcome: Mark the diagnostic setup handoff triggered without placing an order.

setup_decisions.condition: The target's first overlap occurs before qualifying liquidity has taken its own extreme, including an overlap on the same five-minute bar as the liquidity sweep.
setup_decisions.outcome: Reject the diagnostic setup handoff because closed-bar OHLC cannot prove liquidity was taken first.

setup_decisions.condition: The target's first overlap closes beyond its distal boundary.
setup_decisions.outcome: Reject the diagnostic setup handoff instead of treating the invalidated zone as a trigger.

setup_decisions.condition: An armed target and a confirmed opposite zone fully in front of it are both first tapped on the same closed five-minute bar.
setup_decisions.outcome: Reject the diagnostic setup handoff because five-minute OHLC cannot prove the route ordering.

conflicts.resolution: Use the full origin body for accuracy geometry, matching the canonical RD explanation; do not retain the legacy partial wick segment.
Same-direction wick overlap before confirmation extends the formation envelope; only bars after confirmation can tap the frozen zone.
Replace an unformed candidate with each newer opposite candle so the final opposite candle becomes the origin.

Automation requires the objective two-candle minimum. Keep the one-candle exception documented but fail closed until its large-retracement, obvious-zone-fakeout, and clear-direction conditions have approved numeric definitions.
The spatially closest completed swing is the primary gate. Older swept swings remain supporting confidence but cannot override a closer unswept primary.

A slight retracement alone does not expire an eligible setup. Expiration requires the objective later tap of a confirmed opposite-direction raw zone fully in front of the target; an opposite zone closed beyond its distal boundary is invalidated and is not this blocker.
